scene: Your ukulele tune charms the robot bird into dropping three shiny transit tokens.
picture: A flat rooftop transfer hub. On the far left, a sleek bullet train idles along an elevated track. Left of centre, the broad-shouldered Pacific Islander man in a floral shirt, sandals, and top knot holds his ukulele. Centre, a moored solar-sail junk rests atop tiles. Far right, an open glass cloud cable pod swings gently.
shown: a sleek neon bullet train platform with open doors on the far left
a moored wooden junk with glowing solar sails resting on the centre roof
a spherical glass cable car swaying at a dock on the far right
